problem.title: Queue Using Stacks
problem.problemStatement: Design a queue using only two stacks. The queue must support the following operations: push(x) — Insert an element at the back. pop() — Remove and return the front element. peek() — Return the front element without removing it. empty() — Return whether the queue is empty. Process a sequence of operations and print the result of every pop(), peek(), and empty() operation.
problem.input: Integer q Next q lines each contain one operation.
problem.output: Print the output for every pop(), peek(), and empty() operation.
